description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/Martinikaws/spotify-merged-patches/compare/v1.1.3...v1.2.0) (2026-11-11)

### ✨ New Features

* port Spicetify extensions to 9.1.94.1929 and add Shuffle+ preset-order toggle ([c4a2ac0](https://github.com/Martinikaws/spotify-merged-patches/commit/c4a2ac0219a173b5f4969f2350a43a3117b1a650))

patches.name: Block popup ads
patches.description: Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package name and app name so the patched app can be installed alongside the original Spotify app.

options.description: The package name of the patched app. It must differ from the original one.
The name shown in the launcher.

patches.name: Clean sharing links
patches.description: Removes sharing identifiers and marketing parameters from open.spotify.com links. Keeps playback timestamps, context, and other parameters.

patches.name: Disable ad breaks
patches.description: Disables the ad slots that play ads between songs. Experimental.

patches.name: Fix third party launchers widgets
patches.description: Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.

patches.name: Hide Home and Browse ads
patches.description: Hides image and video brand-ad sections on Home and Browse. Does not suppress audio ads, player ads, or upgrade prompts. Experimental.

patches.name: Hide Premium tab
patches.description: Hides the Premium navigation tab. Change this in Spicetify settings, then restart Spotify. Does not change your subscription or remove other ads.

patches.name: Hide ad views
patches.description: Hides ad banners, ad labels, ad overlay controls, the ad player and the audio and embedded ad layouts of the now playing view.

patches.name: Hide context menu upsells
patches.description: Removes "Premium" entries from the context menus of songs, albums and playlists. (Only works on older Spotify versions.)

patches.name: Hide player ad cards
patches.description: Hides image brand-ad cards and embedded ad pages in Now Playing. Does not suppress audio ads or other player overlays. Experimental.

patches.name: Hide video ads
patches.description: Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.

patches.name: Local files from a server
patches.description: Streams audio from an HTTPS WebDAV folder or Jellyfin music library into Local Files and Your Library. Configure the server in Spicetify settings; playback needs Spotify's Local audio files setting. Experimental; requires byte-range support. Not available for root mount installs.

patches.name: Mute audio ads
patches.description: Mutes the music stream while an audio ad plays and restores the volume afterwards. Enabling "Device broadcast status" in the Spotify settings improves the ad detection.

patches.name: Pin shortcuts on Home
patches.description: Pick playlists, albums or Liked Songs to pin first on Home, or turn on Show only my pins to hide Spotify's other shortcuts. Pins are saved on this device; restart Spotify after changing them.

patches.name: Spicetify extensions
patches.description: Adds Android versions of Spicetify extensions to the Spicetify Marketplace's Extensions tab, in Spicetify settings, each off until you turn it on. Trash Bin skips the songs and artists you throw away from their menus. Play a random song plays one from all of Spotify or your library, from a Random pill on Home. Shuffle+ plays a playlist, album or Liked Songs in a truly random order when you long-press the shuffle button in Now Playing, choose Shuffle+ this playlist in a playlist's menu, or use its sheet. Hide podcasts hides podcasts and episodes on Home and in Search, and their filters there and in Your Library, and audiobooks unless you turn that off.

patches.name: Theme colors
patches.description: Choose a theme, such as OLED, or your own colors in Spicetify settings. Requires Android 11 or later. Some screens and hardcoded colors keep Spotify's colors.
